title: JANUS Egypt Research Correspondence — Master Gmail Ledger

authority.raw_body: Gmail remains canonical; this ledger stores source-bound digests rather than duplicating quoted chains.
authority.privacy: Private phone/messenger details are deliberately omitted. Institutional/contact identity, message IDs, subjects, attachments and evidence-relevant summaries are retained.

scope.method: Multiple broad and named Gmail searches plus exact-thread chronology checks; deduplicated by thread_id/message_id.
excluded: non-Egypt research such as Linear A
quoted copies of older messages inside reply bodies
